basis: Lysosomal storage disease with progressive neurodegeneration; damaging retinal dystrophy reported in 5/5 patients.
Schwann-cell tumor of lower cranial nerves; compressive hearing loss occurs in roughly half of patients.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm flagella and motility; reproductive function has no axis.
Severe osteolysis, osteoporosis, lipoatrophy and alopecia define the syndrome; explicit absence of cardiovascular impairment outweighs small-series ECG findings.
Heck disease is HPV-associated focal epithelial proliferation of the oral mucosa.
Benign tumor arising from cutaneous sweat glands of the vulva; sweat-gland origin places it on the skin axis.
ARMC5-associated adrenal hyperplasia with cortisol excess; osteoporosis frequency is insufficiently established for this often mild subtype.
Adhesion of the retracted tympanic membrane to middle-ear structures defines this ear disorder.
Tumor originates in breast tissue, which has no axis; malignant transformation and distant spread are uncommon.
Immune-mediated childhood arthritis with defining psoriatic skin or nail disease; uveitis is occasional, below 30%.
Myeloid marrow neoplasm characterized by dysplasia, anemia and excess circulating or marrow blasts.
Benign reactive proliferation of lymphoid germinal-center cells; the definition establishes that this is not lymphoma despite its parent classification.
Inherited innate immunodeficiency; meningitis, abscesses and skin infections are separately diagnosed infections; reported neutropenia can be transient.
Ear discharge is an auditory-system condition; no specific infectious cause is established.
Inherited displacement of the pupil and lens with iris abnormalities; manifestations are confined to the eye.
Developmental delay, intellectual disability and seizures dominate this variable duplication group; damaging skeletal or palatal defects lack a reliable ≥30% frequency.
Acquired platelet deficiency; the umbrella includes immune and nonimmune causes, so an immune mechanism is not universal.
Basal cell carcinoma originating in skin, with infiltrating malignant epithelial strands and fibrotic stroma.
INS-associated permanent neonatal diabetes causes insulin deficiency; this genetic form is not inherently autoimmune.
Entamoeba infection directly damages intestinal mucosa; hepatic spread is a minority complication and separately diagnosed infection.
Creatine biosynthesis defect defined by cerebral creatine deficiency, developmental impairment, seizures and movement abnormalities.
Compression of the brachial plexus defines the neurogenic subtype; rib variants are predisposing anatomy, and vascular disease is not intrinsic.
Pontocerebellar malformation with severe developmental impairment; strabismus affects 3/3 patients. Hepatic and pleural findings are isolated reports.
Hereditary optic-nerve atrophy with progressive visual loss; the optic nerve belongs to the ocular axis.
Hereditary myelolymphatic insufficiency with leukopenia, abnormal neutrophil segmentation and recurrent bacterial and viral infections.
